status: UNSIGNED — every role authorized:false. Execution remains BTRR_EXECUTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED.
note: To authorize a role an OWNER edits this entry (authorized:true, authorized_by, date, scope_seeds, token_sha256 = sha256 of a plaintext token generated out-of-band, protocol_lock_digest = current experiments.relational_reasoning_bounded_context.manifest.config_digest(), optional expires_at) and COMMITS it. The plaintext token is delivered to the operator out-of-band (never committed) and supplied at run time via env BTRR_EXEC_TOKEN. Both keys are required. Authorizing one role does not authorize the others.
